name: Vertseth
description: Vertseth was a planet in the Vertseth system of the Colonies that was the homeworld of Vertseth Automata, a droid manufacturing company that produced techno-service droids. One such droid was named Todo 360 and operated under the bounty hunter Cad Bane during the Clone Wars.
lead_paragraphs: Vertseth was a planet in the Vertseth system of the Colonies that was the homeworld of Vertseth Automata, a droid manufacturing company that produced techno-service droids. One such droid was named Todo 360 and operated under the bounty hunter Cad Bane during the Clone Wars.
